titolo: Google launches "Polar Peaks" AI Quest to teach brain‑mapping to students
descr: Google Research and Stanford Accelerator debut an interactive game for ages 11‑14 to map neurons using AI, with new teacher training modules.
paragrafi: Google Research and the Stanford Accelerator for Learning have released "Polar Peaks," the third AI Quest aimed at students aged 11 to 14.
The quest lets learners act as researchers, scanning and mapping brain neurons while practicing data cleaning and model testing.
It highlights the need for human oversight in AI and builds critical thinking skills, echoing a decade of Google’s work in connectomics.
Upon completion, students hear from the scientists behind real breakthroughs, including the recent full fruit‑fly brain map, the largest by neuron count.
Google also introduced dedicated teacher training modules through the Google AI Educator Series, with the Quest 3 module arriving next month.
perche: The game provides a hands‑on way for young learners to understand AI’s role in neuroscience, encouraging responsible use. Educators gain ready‑made resources to integrate AI literacy without needing specialized hardware or paid models.
